stem: Based on the ideas presented in paragraphs 3 through 6, what can the reader conclude?

options.label: A
options.text: Parks are more important than other natural areas.

options.label: B
options.text: Preserving nature is an important part of a strong community.

options.label: C
options.text: Families can use parks to fit their different needs.

options.label: D
options.text: People can learn how to use their imagination while in nature.
